_comment: Variables, parameters and properties are named with full words: $entityManager, not $em.
Read by tests/Unit/NamesAreFullWordsTest.php (PHP and Twig) and by the aurora/full-word-names rule of eslint.config.cjs (JS and Vue), so every language follows one list.
abbreviations: a word that may not appear in a name, whether alone ($doc), at the start (docId), inside (viewingDocVersions) or in a constant (DOC_MIME), with what to write instead.

shortNamesAllowed: the only names of one or two letters let through. They are not abbreviations: an acronym (id, ip, io for SymfonyStyle), a language code, a coordinate, a preposition naming a moment or an order ($at, $on, $by), `t` from vue-i18n, or `_` for a value that is not read.

roleSuffixes: a declared dependency is named after what it IS, not after what it returns. A type ending in one of these carries that word in its own name, so $notes never means a MarkdownNoteRepository. Read by tests/Unit/DependenciesAreNamedAfterTheirRoleTest.php.

roleNameExceptions: the few places where the name says which part the thing plays in the scene instead, and no collection is announced. One entry per `path::$name`, with the reason, because an exception nobody has to justify is a hole.

abbreviations.arr: a name saying what the array holds
abbreviations.obj: a name saying what the object is
abbreviations.str: a name saying what the string holds

roleNameExceptions.tests/Unit/Core/Storage/LocalWorkspaceTe: the subject of the test is which disk plays which part; $localStorageAdapter would say the type and lose the staging
paired with $local above, and read as its opposite
roleNameExceptions.tests/Unit/Core/Storage/Command/ExportSt: the export reads from a source and writes to a destination; that pairing is the test
roleNameExceptions.tests/Integration/Core/Storage/DocumentR: paired with $secondary: the test is about moving a document from one to the other
